title: Cyrus and the Hollow
author: O. M. Joubert
blurb: August Dravenmoor, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
